text: もっと　たくさん　うまったら　ぜひ　わしに　みせにきてくれ！

structure.jp: もっと　たくさん　うまったら
structure.en: when it fills up a lot more

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら means 'when' or 'if' something happens. うまったら = 'when it gets filled'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に says the reason for going or coming. みせにくる = 'come to show'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: てくれ is a blunt request for someone to do something for you. きてくれ = 'please come'.
